era: 清末至台湾时期 / Late Qing to Taiwan era (1891-1962)
school: 实验主义/白话文运动/学术方法论 / Experimentalism / Vernacular Language Movement / Scholarly Methodology
historical_significance: 新文化运动的核心旗手，白话文运动的首倡者，中国现代学术范式的奠基人之一。核心方法论：以『大胆的假设，小心的求证』十字诀重写治学程序、以历史演化眼光（『历史的态度』）把一切制度与价值看作可变的演进序列、以『研究问题，输入学理，整理国故，再造文明』为新文明的建设性纲领、以白话文革命把认知工具从文言贵族手里交给大众、以『多研究些问题，少谈些主义』把论战拉回可验证的具体问题层面、以容忍与自由互为条件化解教条冲突、以『功不唐捐』的长期主义对冲一时成败。他是把怀疑精神制度化、把改良主义操作化的转换器式人物。
historical_significance_en: The central standard-bearer of the New Culture Movement, initiator of the vernacular language revolution, and a founder of modern Chinese scholarship. Core methodology: the ten-character formula 'bold hypotheses, careful verification' rewriting the procedure of inquiry, the historical attitude (evolutionary vision) that treats every institution and value as a mutable evolving series, the constructive program of 'study problems, import theories, reorganize the national heritage, recreate civilization,' the vernacular revolution that handed the instrument of cognition from the classical-literati elite to the masses, 'study more problems, talk less of isms' to pull polemics back to the level of verifiable specific questions, tolerance and liberty as mutual conditions for dissolving dogmatic conflict, and the long-termism of 'no effort is ever wasted' to hedge short-term outcomes. He was a converter-figure who institutionalized the spirit of doubt and operationalized reformism.
unique_thinking: 新文化运动的核心旗手，白话文运动的首倡者，中国现代学术范式的奠基人之一。核心方法论：以『大胆的假设，小心的求证』十字诀重写治学程序、以历史演化眼光（『历史的态度』）把一切制度与价值看作可变的演进序列、以『研究问题，输入学理，整理国故，再造文明』为新文明的建设性纲领、以白话文革命把认知工具从文言贵族手里交给大众、以『多研究些问题，少谈些主义』把论战拉回可验证的具体问题层面、以容忍与自由互为条件化解教条冲突、以『功不唐捐』的长期主义对冲一时成败。他是把怀疑精神制度化、把改良主义操作化的转换器式人物。
unique_thinking_en: The central standard-bearer of the New Culture Movement, initiator of the vernacular language revolution, and a founder of modern Chinese scholarship. Core methodology: the ten-character formula 'bold hypotheses, careful verification' rewriting the procedure of inquiry, the historical attitude (evolutionary vision) that treats every institution and value as a mutable evolving series, the constructive program of 'study problems, import theories, reorganize the national heritage, recreate civilization,' the vernacular revolution that handed the instrument of cognition from the classical-literati elite to the masses, 'study more problems, talk less of isms' to pull polemics back to the level of verifiable specific questions, tolerance and liberty as mutual conditions for dissolving dogmatic conflict, and the long-termism of 'no effort is ever wasted' to hedge short-term outcomes. He was a converter-figure who institutionalized the spirit of doubt and operationalized reformism.
roles_en: Leader of the Vernacular Language Movement
Standard-bearer of the New Culture Movement
key_works: 《水浒传考证》与古典小说考证系列
《介绍我自己的思想》与《治学方法》讲演

cross_references.relation_type: 师承关系：实验主义的老师与学生
cross_references.description_zh: 胡适师从杜威，把实用主义方法凝练为『大胆的假设，小心的求证』十字诀（M-HS-001）；杜威以探究五步法奠定实验主义认识论（M-DY 系列）。胡适是杜威方法在中文世界的转译者与制度推广者。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Shih studied under Dewey and condensed pragmatist method into the ten-character formula 'bold hypotheses, careful verification' (M-HS-001); Dewey founded experimentalist epistemology with the five-step inquiry (M-DY series). Hu Shih was the translator-institutionalizer of Dewey's method in the Chinese-speaking world.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 杜威档案（H-DY-001）未来修订时可在『探究五步法』处补一条指向 H-HS-001 的跨引用（方法的中文转译与推广）。

cross_references.relation_type: 同门异径：一个改文字工具，一个改生活学校
cross_references.description_zh: 陶行知同样师承杜威，把『教育即生活』翻转为『生活即教育』（M-TXZ 系列）；胡适把认知工具从文言改为白话（M-HS-004）。两人同属新教育运动，一个改造书面思维的语言界面，一个改造身体力行的教育场域。
cross_references.description_en: Tao Xingzhi, also Dewey's student, flipped 'education as life' into 'life as education' (M-TXZ series); Hu Shih changed the instrument of cognition from classical to vernacular Chinese (M-HS-004). Both belonged to the new education movement—one reforming the linguistic interface of thought, the other the field of embodied learning.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 陶行知档案（H-TXZ-001）未来修订时可在『生活教育』处补一条指向 H-HS-001 的跨引用（白话文作为教育普及的前提工具）。

cross_references.relation_type: 整理国故：以科学方法重估传统
cross_references.description_zh: 胡适『整理国故』以历史演化眼光把儒家经典当作可变的演进序列来考证（M-HS-002/M-HS-007）；孔子本身是传统叙事的原点。胡适对孔教的批判与对哲学史的重写，是传统与现代性最正面的方法论对撞。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Shih's 'reorganizing the national heritage' treated the Confucian classics as a mutable evolutionary series under historical verification (M-HS-002/M-HS-007); Confucius himself is the origin point of that tradition. Hu Shih's critique of Confucian religion and his rewrite of the history of philosophy form the most direct methodological collision of tradition and modernity.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 孔子档案（H-CC-001）未来修订时可在『仁与礼』处补一条指向 H-HS-001 的跨引用（现代学术范式下的重估）。

cross_references.relation_type: 怀疑与求证的西东对照
cross_references.description_zh: 康德以批判哲学划定理性的边界（M-KD 系列）；胡适以实验主义拒绝玄学独断，把一切判断交给证据裁决（M-HS-001/M-HS-005）。两者都把『未经审察的断言』拒之门外，康德用先验论证，胡适用可验证假设。
cross_references.description_en: Kant demarcated the limits of reason through critical philosophy (M-KD series); Hu Shih rejected metaphysical dogmatism via experimentalism, submitting every judgment to evidence (M-HS-001/M-HS-005). Both bar 'unexamined assertion'—Kant with transcendental argument, Hu Shih with testable hypotheses.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 康德档案（H-KD-001）未来修订时可在『批判方法』处补一条指向 H-HS-001 的跨引用（证据裁决对先验论证的平行版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 怀疑的方法化：普遍怀疑 vs 实验怀疑
cross_references.description_zh: 笛卡尔以普遍怀疑清洗预设、抵达不可怀疑的基点（M-DKR 系列）；胡适的怀疑不寻找绝对基点，而指向可修正的假设与证据链（M-HS-001/M-HS-002）。一个是奠基式怀疑，一个是渐进修正式怀疑。
cross_references.description_en: Descartes used universal doubt to purge presuppositions and reach an indubitable foundation (M-DKR series); Hu Shih's doubt seeks no absolute foundation but aims at revisable hypotheses and chains of evidence (M-HS-001/M-HS-002). One is foundation-seeking doubt, the other progressive, self-correcting doubt.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 笛卡尔档案（H-DKR-001）未来修订时可在『普遍怀疑』处补一条指向 H-HS-001 的跨引用（非奠基式怀疑的对照版本）。

modes.domain_zh: 科学方法论的本土化/学术程序设计
modes.domain_en: Localizing Scientific Method / Designing Procedures of Inquiry
modes.definition_zh: 胡适面对的根本问题是：中国有考据传统但没有系统的科学方法，杜威的实验主义又太哲学化，普通人拿不动。他的解法是把实验主义压缩成十字诀——『大胆的假设，小心的求证』。假设要大胆，因为不大胆就提不出有信息量的命题；求证要小心，因为证据是唯一能处死错误假设的刑具。两者缺一即废：只有大胆没有小心是清谈，只有小心没有大胆是抄卡片。方法上这意味着：把一套复杂方法论压缩为可执行、可传诵的最小程序对（生成假设的自由度 + 检验假设的严格度），让非专业人士也能照做。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih faced a fundamental problem: China had a philological tradition but no systematic scientific method, while Dewey's experimentalism was too philosophical for ordinary hands. His solution was to compress experimentalism into a ten-character formula—'bold hypotheses, careful verification.' Hypotheses must be bold, for without boldness no informative proposition gets proposed; verification must be careful, for evidence is the only executioner of wrong hypotheses. Either half alone fails: boldness without care is empty talk; care without boldness is card-copying. Methodologically: compress a complex methodology into a minimal executable, transmissible procedure-pair (freedom for generating hypotheses + rigor for testing them), so non-specialists can follow it too.
modes.source_chapter: 《清代学者的治学方法》论考据与科学方法同构；《介绍我自己的思想》自述『大胆的假设，小心的求证』十字诀
modes.key_quote_zh: 大胆的假设，小心的求证——假设不大胆，不能有新发明；证据不充分，不能使人信仰。
modes.key_quote_en: Bold hypotheses, careful verification—without bold hypotheses no new discoveries; without sufficient evidence, no conviction.
process_zh: 对悬而未决的问题，先故意提出反直觉、有信息量的假设（宁可大胆，不可平庸）
把假设翻译成『若为真，则应能找到何类证据』的可检验形式
以最严格的证据标准去搜求证伪材料——主动去找能杀死自己假设的证据
证据不足时悬而不断，把结论的置信度与证据强度对齐
process_en: For an open problem, deliberately propose counter-intuitive, informative hypotheses (prefer bold over bland)
Translate the hypothesis into testable form: 'if true, what kind of evidence should exist?'
Search for disconfirming material under the strictest standards—actively hunt evidence that could kill your own hypothesis
Suspend judgment when evidence is insufficient; align the confidence of conclusions with the strength of evidence
representative_cases_zh: 以『大胆假设』提出《红楼梦》是曹雪芹自叙传，再以『小心求证』遍搜史料，创立新红学，把索隐派的附言整体淘汰
考据《水浒传》版本演进时假设存在一个不断累积的成书过程，再用各版本异文逐层验证
在《中国哲学史大纲》中把『述学、明变、求因、评判』立为哲学史研究程序，使哲学史从经学附庸变为科学学科
反例警示：其古史推论中亦有假设先行、证据后补之处（如对某些古书的年代判断过激），被顾颉刚等人以更严格的证据标准修正——十字诀少了后半句就会反噬自身
representative_cases_en: Boldly hypothesizing that Dream of the Red Chamber was Cao Xueqin's autobiographical novel, then carefully combing the sources, he founded New Redology and routed the allegorical school
Textual studies of the Water Margin hypothesized an accretive, layered process of composition, verified layer by layer through variant editions

In his Outline of the History of Chinese Philosophy he fixed 'documenting, tracing change, finding causes, judging' as the procedure of intellectual history, turning it from a handmaiden of classics into a scientific discipline
Counterexample: some of his ancient-text datings outran their evidence and were corrected by Gu Jiegang and others under stricter standards—drop the second half of the formula and it turns on itself
modern_applications_zh: 科研训练：把导师的隐性直觉写成『假设自由度+证伪严格度』两个可考核指标
商业决策：先强制生成三个以上互斥假设，再分别设计最廉价的证伪实验
数据分析：以『找反例』替代『找支持』，避免确认偏误
产品迭代：假设可以激进，A/B 测试的判定标准必须预先冻结
modern_applications_en: Research training: write a mentor's tacit intuition into two assessable metrics—hypothesis boldness and disconfirmation rigor
Business decisions: force three mutually exclusive hypotheses, then design the cheapest falsifying test for each
Data analysis: hunt counterexamples instead of supporting cases to defeat confirmation bias
Product iteration: hypotheses may be aggressive, but freeze the A/B decision criteria in advance

modes.domain_zh: 把一切制度与观念看作可变的演进序列
modes.domain_en: Treating All Institutions and Ideas as Mutable Evolving Series
modes.definition_zh: 胡适说的『历史的态度』（historical attitude）是一种元方法：任何制度、文本、观念都不是天生如此，而是从某个源头开始一层层演化出来的。一旦看清它是『怎么变成这样的』，它的神圣性与必然性就自动瓦解——文言文不是汉语的天然形态，只是两千年书写制度的沉积；贞节不是永恒道德，只是某一时代的规范。这套眼光既用于解放（去魅），也用于研究（追问演化链条上的每一次变异及其原因）。方法上这意味着：面对任何『理所当然』之物，先追问它的发生史；神圣感往往是演化过程被遗忘的症状。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih's 'historical attitude' is a meta-method: no institution, text, or idea is naturally what it is—it evolved, layer by layer, from some origin. Once you see how it 'came to be this way,' its sacredness and inevitability dissolve on their own—classical Chinese is not the natural form of the language but the sediment of two millennia of writing institutions; chastity is not eternal morality but the norm of one era. This vision serves both liberation (demystification) and research (asking after each mutation in the evolutionary chain and its causes). Methodologically: for anything that seems self-evident, first ask for its genesis; a sense of the sacred is often the symptom of a forgotten evolution.
modes.source_chapter: 《新思潮的意义》提出『评判的态度』与『历史的眼光』；《中国哲学史大纲》导言论述学须明变求因
modes.key_quote_zh: 研究问题要下工夫，须要有历史的眼光——一切制度都是历史的产物，知道了它的来历，便不觉得它神圣不可侵犯。
modes.key_quote_en: Studying a problem takes a historical vision—every institution is a product of history; once you know where it came from, it no longer seems too sacred to touch.
process_zh: 锁定被视为当然的对象（制度、文类、道德律），拒绝从其当下形态出发
向上追溯演化链条：找出最早可考的形态与每一次重大变异的节点
对每次变异追问动力：什么条件使旧形态无法维持、新形态胜出
以演化史重新给对象定位：它此刻的形态只是链条上的暂时均衡，可以继续演化
process_en: Lock onto the object taken for granted (institution, genre, moral rule) and refuse to start from its present form
Trace the evolutionary chain upward: find the earliest attested form and the nodes of each major mutation
Ask the driver of each mutation: what conditions made the old form untenable and the new form win
Relocate the object via its history: its present shape is only a temporary equilibrium in the chain, capable of further evolution
representative_cases_zh: 《白话文学史》把白话文学重写为中国文学的正统主线，使『文言是正统』的历史叙事从内部崩塌，为白话文革命提供合法性
考证《镜花缘》《水浒传》等的成书过程，示范『一切大著作都是演化物』的文本史观
论贞节问题：指出表彰节烈是特定历史条件的产物而非普遍道德，直接推动社会观念松动
反例警示：演化眼光若被简化为『凡新的必胜过旧的』，就会滑向另一种教条——胡适晚年反复强调历史的态度同时要求对『新潮』同样考证，不因其新而免检
representative_cases_en: His History of Vernacular Literature rewrote vernacular writing as the orthodox mainstream of Chinese letters, collapsing 'classical Chinese as orthodoxy' from within and legitimizing the vernacular revolution
His textual studies of how works like Flowers in the Mirror and the Water Margin were composed modeled the view that all great texts are evolutionary products
On chastity: showing that honoring widow-martyrs was the product of specific historical conditions, not universal morality, directly loosening social attitudes

Counterexample: the evolutionary vision, simplified into 'whatever is new must beat the old,' becomes another dogma—in later years Hu Shih stressed that the historical attitude demands equal scrutiny of the new, which gets no exemption for its novelty
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革：先给旧流程写演化史，找出每条规矩当初解决的是什么问题，再判断问题是否仍存在
行业分析：把『行业惯例』还原为历史均衡点，寻找下一个变异的条件
产品史观：一切头部产品的当前形态都是暂时的，研究其形态演化链比抄当前形态更有价值
个人观念更新：对自身固有信念做起源审计——我为什么相信它？
modern_applications_en: Organizational change: write the evolutionary history of an old process—what problem did each rule originally solve, and does it still exist?
Industry analysis: reduce 'industry conventions' to historical equilibria and look for the next mutation's conditions
Product vision: every leading product's current form is temporary; its form-evolution chain is worth more than copying the present shape
Personal belief updates: run an origin audit on your own convictions—why do I believe this?

modes.domain_zh: 把主义话语还原为具体问题
modes.domain_en: Reducing Ideological Discourse to Concrete Problems
modes.definition_zh: 1919年『问题与主义』论战中，胡适面对的现象是：抽象主义话语正在吞噬公共讨论——人人谈根本解决，个个谈论主义，具体问题（人力车夫的生计、大总统的权限、加入何种联盟）反而无人研究。他的解法是设立一道过滤程序：任何宏大主张必须先分解为若干可研究、可验证、可逐步解决的具体问题，否则不予讨论。这不反主义本身，而是拒绝主义作为免检通行证。方法上这意味着：当讨论被抽象名词绑架时，用『这个主张具体要求改变什么？证据何在？第一步做什么？』把对话拉回可操作层面。
modes.definition_en: In the 1919 debate on 'Problems and Isms,' Hu Shih faced this phenomenon: abstract ideological discourse was devouring public discussion—everyone preached total solutions and talked isms, while concrete problems (rickshaw pullers' livelihoods, the president's powers, which alliance to join) went unstudied. His solution was a filtering procedure: any grand claim must first be decomposed into specific problems that can be studied, verified, and solved stepwise, or it is refused discussion. He did not oppose isms as such; he refused to let an ism serve as an inspection-free pass. Methodologically: when discussion is hijacked by abstract nouns, pull it back to the operable level with 'what does this claim concretely propose to change? where is the evidence? what is the first step?'
modes.source_chapter: 《多研究些问题，少谈些「主义」》(1919)；《三论问题与主义》论主义的假设性
modes.key_quote_zh: 主义起于问题……空谈好听的『主义』是极容易的事，是阿猫阿狗都能做的事，研究问题才是极困难的事。
modes.key_quote_en: Isms arise from problems... To prate of a pleasing 'ism' is the easiest thing in the world—any cat or dog can do it; studying problems is what is truly hard.
process_zh: 识别讨论中的抽象名词与一揽子承诺（『根本解决』『彻底改造』）
对每个大主张追问三件事：具体要改变什么？依据什么证据？第一步行动是什么？
把通过过滤的主张登记为问题清单，按可解决性与紧迫性排序
以逐个问题的解决进度作为评判标准的唯一来源，拒绝用主义站队替代验证
process_en: Identify abstract nouns and package promises in a discussion ('total solution,' 'thorough transformation')
Ask three things of every grand claim: what concretely to change? on what evidence? what is the first step?
Register claims that pass the filter as a problem list, ranked by solvability and urgency
Judge by the solving progress on problems alone; refuse to substitute ism-alignment for verification
representative_cases_zh: 《多研究些问题，少谈些「主义」》一口气列出人力车夫生计、大总统权限、卖淫问题、大解四合等十余个具体问题，示范清单式的问题主义
他把『根本解决论』归为懒人哲学：用一句总括口号免除逐题研究的辛苦
推动『每周评论』以具体时评代替政论口号，把公共写作锚定在事件与证据上
反例警示：李大钊回应指出主义与问题不可偏废——没有统摄框架的逐题改良可能只见树木；胡适承认这一点，其立场实为『主义须经问题检验』而非取消主义
representative_cases_en: 'Study More Problems, Talk Less of Isms' lists a dozen concrete problems in one breath—rickshaw pullers' livelihood, the president's powers, prostitution—modeling isms as inventories of problems
He classed 'total-solution talk' as a lazy man's philosophy: one umbrella slogan exempting one from the toil of problem-by-problem study
He steered the Weekly Critic toward concrete commentary instead of political slogans, anchoring public writing in events and evidence

Counterexample: Li Dazhao replied that isms and problems cannot be neglected in favor of either—stepwise reform without an integrating framework may see only trees; Hu Shih conceded this, his real position being 'isms must pass the test of problems,' not the abolition of isms
modern_applications_zh: 会议治理：立规——任何提案必须附『第一步做什么』才准上会
战略评审：拒绝『数字化转型』式大词，要求拆成带验证节点的问题序列
公共辩论：用『证据何在』过滤情绪性口号，把辩论变成问题研究
AI 时代的信息筛选：对宏大叙事先做可验证性拆解再决定立场
modern_applications_en: Meeting governance: a rule—no proposal reaches the agenda without 'what is the first step?'
Strategy reviews: refuse big nouns like 'digital transformation'; require decomposition into a problem sequence with verification nodes
Public debate: filter emotional slogans with 'where is the evidence?' and turn debate into problem study
Information triage in the AI age: decompose grand narratives for verifiability before taking sides

modes.domain_zh: 认知工具的下沉/传播介质革命
modes.domain_en: Downsizing Cognitive Tools / Revolutionizing the Medium of Transmission
modes.definition_zh: 胡适观察到：中国的知识垄断不在学校而在文字——文言是一门需要十年苦学才能掌握的排他性工具，掌握它的人构成一个靠工具壁垒维系的士大夫阶级。白话文运动的本质不是文学风格之争，而是工具革命：把表达与阅读的成本降低一个数量级，让识字与思考脱钩于阶级。他的策略耐人寻味——不写理论檄文而写《文学改良刍议》这样温和的『刍议』，用『历史演化的文学史论』证明白话自古是活文学，让革命以『复归正统』的面目出现，降低反对面。方法上这意味着：当瓶颈是一套排他性工具时，最深的革命是替换工具本身，且要为革命设计一条阻力最小的合法性叙事。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih observed that China's monopoly on knowledge lay not in schools but in script—classical Chinese was an exclusionary tool requiring a decade of bitter study, and its masters formed a literati class sustained by the tool barrier itself. The vernacular movement was thus not a quarrel over literary style but a tool revolution: cut the cost of expression and reading by an order of magnitude, decoupling literacy and thinking from class. His strategy is telling—not a thunderous manifesto but the mild 'Modest Proposals for Literary Reform,' and a literary history proving the vernacular had always been living literature, so that the revolution arrived in the guise of 'returning to orthodoxy,' minimizing resistance. Methodologically: when the bottleneck is an exclusionary tool, the deepest revolution is replacing the tool itself—and design the least-resistant legitimacy narrative for the revolution.
modes.source_chapter: 《文学改良刍议》(1917) 八事；《建设的文学革命论》『国语的文学，文学的国语』
modes.key_quote_zh: 要有活的文学，先要有活的语言；白话是文学的正宗，是几千年来活人用活的语言写出的活文学。
modes.key_quote_en: For living literature you first need a living language; the vernacular is the true vein of literature—the living literature written by living people in living language for millennia.
process_zh: 诊断瓶颈是否为『工具本身』而非工具的使用者或制度
为替代工具建立合法性叙事：证明新工具并非外来嫁接，而是被遗忘的正统
以最小清单发布改革纲领（八不主义），使其可传诵、可执行、可模仿
用示范作品（自己的白话诗集、剧本、学术著作）证明新工具的上限，堵住『白话不能表达高深思想』的质疑
process_en: Diagnose whether the bottleneck is the tool itself, not its users or institutions
Build a legitimacy narrative for the replacement tool: show the new tool is not a foreign graft but a forgotten orthodoxy
Publish the program as a minimal checklist (the Eight Don'ts), making it transmissible, executable, imitable
Prove the new tool's ceiling with demonstration works (your own vernacular poems, plays, scholarship), sealing off the objection that the vernacular cannot carry deep thought
representative_cases_zh: 《文学改良刍议》以『须言之有物、不摹仿古人、不作无病之呻吟』等八事取代口号式革命宣言，成为新文学的形式宪法
《尝试集》以自身的不完美承担示范成本：先证明白话可以成诗，质量之辩留给后人
《中国哲学史大纲》用白话写学术著作，直接证明白话能承载最高复杂度的思想表达
反例警示：白话革命也带来浅薄化与速成的批评（章太炎一系讥其浅），说明工具下沉必然伴随使用门槛降低后的质量分布下移——这是革命的成本而非意外的故障
representative_cases_en: 'Modest Proposals for Literary Reform' set the Eight Don'ts—'have substance, do not imitate the ancients, do not moan without illness'—replacing slogan revolution as the formal constitution of new literature
Changshi (Experiments) bore the demonstration cost with its own imperfections: first prove the vernacular can make poems; leave the quality debate to posterity
His Outline of the History of Chinese Philosophy wrote scholarship in the vernacular, directly proving it can bear the highest complexity of thought

Counterexample: the revolution drew charges of shallowness and instant gratification (the Zhang Taiyan school mocked its thinness)—tool downsizing necessarily lowers the quality floor once the entry barrier falls; that is the cost of revolution, not an accidental glitch
modern_applications_zh: 知识产品化：把专业知识从 PDF/论文格式下沉为教程、视频、模板——降低的是表达介质成本
组织沟通革命：把『向上汇报的文言』（黑话、PPT 修辞）替换为白话（一页纸、直陈式）
低代码/无代码运动的参照：替换排他性工具时，先做合法性叙事（『人人都是开发者』），再用示范作品堵质疑
开源社区：以最小清单（行为准则、贡献指南）替代长篇纲领
modern_applications_en: Knowledge productization: sink expertise from PDF/paper format into tutorials, videos, templates—cutting the cost of the medium
Organizational communication revolution: replace 'upward-reporting classical' (jargon, slide rhetoric) with vernacular (one page, plain statement)
A lesson for low-code/no-code: when replacing an exclusionary tool, build the legitimacy narrative first ('everyone is a developer'), then plug objections with demonstration works
Open-source communities: minimal checklists (code of conduct, contribution guides) over long manifestos

modes.domain_zh: 结论置信度与证据强度对齐
modes.domain_en: Aligning Conclusion Confidence with Evidence Strength
modes.definition_zh: 胡适治学的标志性纪律是：证据到哪里，结论就到哪里；证据不够，宁可悬而不判。他考据《红楼梦》作者问题时明确区分『已证实的』与『暂定的』，把曹雪芹的自传说标为可修正的假说而非定论。这套纪律的背景是对中国旧学两种病的诊断：一是武断（证据不足强下结论），二是盲从（古人说了就算）。悬判不是懦弱，而是把『不知』公开展示为学术坐标——让后续研究者知道哪块地基是实的、哪块是悬空的。方法上这意味着：结论必须携带自己的证据标签（已证/暂定/悬判），并预留被推翻的接口。
modes.definition_en: The signature discipline of Hu Shih's scholarship: conclusions go only as far as the evidence; where evidence is wanting, suspend judgment. In tracing the authorship of Dream of the Red Chamber he explicitly separated 'the proven' from 'the tentative,' marking the self-fiction hypothesis of Cao Xueqin as a revisable hypothesis, not a verdict. The backdrop is his diagnosis of two diseases of old scholarship: arbitrariness (conclusions outrunning evidence) and blind deference (what the ancients said settles it). Suspension is not timidity but a public display of 'not knowing' as an academic coordinate—letting later researchers know which part of the foundation is solid and which hangs in air. Methodologically: every conclusion must carry its own evidence label (proven / tentative / suspended) and leave an interface for refutation.
modes.source_chapter: 《红楼梦考证》改定稿自述证据等级与暂定结论；《介绍我自己的思想》论『有一分证据，说一分话』
modes.key_quote_zh: 有一分证据，只可说一分话；有三分证据，然后可说三分话——治国学必须处处存一个搜求证据的目的。
modes.key_quote_en: With one measure of evidence, say one measure; with three measures, say three—in studying the heritage, everywhere hold the purpose of hunting evidence.
process_zh: 为每个候选结论盘点证据：直接证据、间接证据、无证据各占多少
按证据强度给结论贴标签：已证实/暂定/存疑，标签与结论绑定发布
对证据不足的部分显式宣布悬判，并说明补齐证据需要什么材料
新的反证出现时，按承诺的接口自动降级或推翻旧结论，不为面子护短
process_en: Inventory evidence for each candidate conclusion: direct, indirect, none—how much of each
Label conclusions by evidence strength: proven / tentative / open, label bound to the conclusion on publication
Explicitly declare suspension where evidence falls short, and state what material would complete it
When counter-evidence arrives, downgrade or overturn per the promised interface—never defend for face
representative_cases_zh: 《红楼梦考证》两易其稿：初稿据袁枚记载定曹雪芹为曹寅之子，新证据出现后公开修正为曹寅之孙，并坦承此前误信孤证
他在哲学史写作中大量标注『此章材料可疑，姑存而不论』，把疑点写进正文而非藏进脚注
对井田辨等争论，他不因对方阵营而全盘否认，逐条以证据等级回应
反例警示：其晚年对《水经注》案投入二十余年，被讥为大师做小考证——悬判纪律的边界是机会成本：证据游戏本身也可能变成回避大问题的舒适区
representative_cases_en: His Red Chamber textual study went through two drafts: the first, on Yuan Mei's testimony, made Cao Xueqin Cao Yin's son; new evidence led him to correct it publicly to grandson, admitting his earlier reliance on a lone source
In writing intellectual history he often marked passages 'the material here is dubious; held in reserve,' putting doubts in the body text, not the footnotes
In debates such as the well-field system he answered point by point by evidence grade, refusing blanket denial by camp

Counterexample: he spent over twenty years on the Shuijingzhu case in old age, mocked as a master doing minor philology—the limit of the suspension discipline is opportunity cost: the evidence game itself can become a comfort zone evading big questions
modern_applications_zh: 研究报告规范：每个结论附置信度与反证条件，读者可自行折价
投资纪律：观点与仓位对齐证据等级，『暂定结论』不得上重仓
组织决策留痕：把『当时已知/当时未知』写进决策记录，替代事后归因
AI 输出治理：要求模型输出标注证据来源与不确定性，而非流畅的确定语气
modern_applications_en: Research-report norms: every conclusion carries a confidence grade and refutation conditions; readers discount at will
Investment discipline: align positions with evidence grades—a 'tentative conclusion' never takes a heavy position
Organizational decision logging: record 'known then / unknown then,' replacing hindsight attribution
AI output governance: require models to label evidence sources and uncertainty, not fluent confidence

modes.domain_zh: 新文明的建设性纲领设计
modes.domain_en: Designing a Constructive Program for a New Civilization
modes.definition_zh: 胡适批评新文化运动中的两种失败姿态：一是国粹派的『保存』（把文明当标本），二是全盘摧毁派的『破坏』（只有拆没有建）。他给出的纲领是四件事——『研究问题，输入学理，整理国故，再造文明』：问题提供现实动力，学理提供工具库存，整理国故使旧资源在新框架下可再生，最后的落点是再造而非守成或清空。这套纲领的关键在『整理』二字：不是判旧学死刑，而是把它送进现代学术程序重新登记。方法上这意味着：文明转型的建设性路线是四步并举的流水线——没有问题导向会空转，没有学理会低效，没有整理国故会断根，没有再造落点会沦为整理癖。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih criticized two failed postures in the New Culture Movement: the classicists' 'preservation' (treating civilization as a specimen) and the total-destroyers' 'demolition' (all teardown, no build). His program had four items—'study problems, import theories, reorganize the national heritage, recreate civilization': problems supply the live drive, theories the tool inventory, reorganizing the heritage makes old resources renewable under a new framework, and the terminus is recreation, not preservation or clearing. The pivot is 'reorganize': not sentencing old learning to death but enrolling it in modern scholarly procedure for re-registration. Methodologically: the constructive route of civilizational transition is a four-step pipeline run in parallel—without problem orientation it idles; without imported theory it is inefficient; without reorganizing the heritage it severs roots; without recreation as terminus it degenerates into a reorganizing mania.
modes.source_chapter: 《新思潮的意义》(1919) 全文：研究问题、输入学理、整理国故、再造文明
modes.key_quote_zh: 新思潮的唯一目的是再造文明——文明不是笼统造成的，是一点一滴造成的。
modes.key_quote_en: The sole aim of the new intellectual current is to recreate civilization—civilization is not made wholesale, but drop by drop.
process_zh: 开问题清单：从当下生活中列出真实痛感的问题序列，作为运动的问题库
建学理库存：系统翻译与引进方法论工具，使每个问题有可用的分析武器
设整理程序：把旧学术按现代标准重新分类、注释、编目，使其可被新框架调用
立再造落点：定期检查四步的产出是否汇聚为新的建设性成果，防止运动退化为批判表演
process_en: Open a problem list: derive from present life a sequence of genuinely felt problems as the movement's problem bank
Build a theory inventory: systematically translate and import methodological tools so every problem has usable analytical weapons
Set a reorganizing procedure: reclassify, annotate, and catalog old scholarship to modern standards so the new framework can call on it
Fix the recreation terminus: periodically check whether the four steps' outputs converge into constructive results, lest the movement decay into a performance of critique
representative_cases_zh: 他主导的整理国故运动把古典小说、诸子学纳入现代学术整理程序，《水浒传考证》《中国哲学史大纲》即『整理』的示范品
倡导用西洋哲学方法整理中国哲学，使经学材料第一次被当作哲学史材料使用
推动北京大学研究所国学门建立新式整理规程（编目、版本、真伪甄别）
反例警示：整理国故后来被保守派借去当『钻故纸堆』的挡箭牌，胡适不得不公开重申整理的目的是再造而非玩古董——纲领被截取一半就会变成自己的反义词
representative_cases_en: The heritage-reorganizing movement he led enrolled classical fiction and pre-Qin philosophy into modern scholarly procedure; his Water Margin studies and Philosophy Outline were its demonstration pieces
He championed reorganizing Chinese philosophy with Western philosophical method, so classics materials were used as intellectual history for the first time
He pushed Peking University's Institute of National Studies to adopt modern reorganizing protocols (cataloging, editions, authenticity screening)

Counterexample: conservatives later borrowed 'reorganizing the heritage' as cover for burrowing into old papers, forcing Hu Shih to restate publicly that the aim was recreation, not curio-play—a program halved becomes its own antonym
modern_applications_zh: 企业转型：问题（业务痛点）、学理（新方法论引入）、整理（存量资产重登记）、再造（新产品线）四步并行
组织知识管理：档案数字化不是终点，检查是否汇入再造环节
开源社区治理：新贡献（学理）与旧代码重整（整理）双轨，以可发布成果为落点
个人成长：以解决问题为纲，避免『收藏式学习』与『纯批判姿态』两种空转
modern_applications_en: Corporate transformation: problems (business pain), theories (new methodology imports), reorganizing (re-registering legacy assets), recreating (new product lines)—run in parallel
Organizational knowledge management: digitizing archives is not the terminus; check whether output feeds the recreation stage
Open-source governance: dual tracks of new contribution (theory) and legacy-code reorganization, converging on shippable results
Personal growth: problem-solving as the spine, avoiding the two idle modes of 'collector learning' and 'pure critique'

modes.domain_zh: 自由的条件结构/异见的伦理基础
modes.domain_en: The Conditional Structure of Liberty / The Ethical Basis of Dissent
modes.definition_zh: 胡适晚年提出他自称最重要的洞见：容忍比自由更重要，容忍是一切自由的根本——没有容忍异己的雅量，任何人都可能在掌权后用自己的『自由』去压别人的自由。他给这个命题一个认识论地基：一切关于『绝对正确』的确信（他自己青年时代的『必以吾辈所主张者为绝对之是』就曾如此）都是不容忍的心理根源；而人是易错的，谁也没有资格自认终审。方法上这意味着：自由不是靠宣告获得，而是靠培养一种对自己确信的怀疑习惯来维护；你为异己保留的空间，正是你自己的自由在下一个政权手里的唯一担保。
modes.definition_en: In his later years Hu Shih offered what he called his most important insight: tolerance matters more than liberty, and tolerance is the root of all freedom—without the magnanimity to tolerate dissenters, anyone in power may use his own 'liberty' to suppress the liberty of others. He gave the thesis an epistemic base: all conviction of 'absolute rightness' (his own youthful belief that 'what we hold must be absolutely right' was one such) is the psychological source of intolerance; and since humans are fallible, no one is entitled to sit as final judge. Methodologically: liberty is won not by proclamation but by cultivating the habit of doubting one's own convictions; the space you reserve for dissenters is the only guarantee your own freedom will have in the next regime's hands.
modes.source_chapter: 《容忍与自由》(1959)：《布尔先生》回忆与自述『必以吾辈所主张者为绝对之是』之悔
modes.key_quote_zh: 容忍是一切自由的根本——没有容忍，就没有自由。
modes.key_quote_en: Tolerance is the root of all freedom—without tolerance there is no freedom.
process_zh: 审计自己的『绝对之是』清单：哪些信念被我视作不容讨论的终审结论
给每个终审信念补上易错性标签：我可能在哪些条件下错了
主动为异己观点设立受保护空间（发表、辩论、免于报复），并公开承诺不行使终审权
以制度而非人格担保：把容忍写成规则（如辩论程序、议事规则），使其不依赖掌权者的雅量
process_en: Audit your list of 'absolute rights': which beliefs do I hold as beyond discussion, as final verdicts
Attach a fallibility label to each terminal belief: under what conditions might I be wrong
Actively create protected space for dissent (publication, debate, immunity from retaliation) and publicly pledge never to exercise final judgment
Guarantee by institution, not personality: write tolerance into rules (debate procedures, rules of order) so it does not depend on the magnanimity of whoever holds power
representative_cases_zh: 《容忍与自由》以宗教改革史为据：高尔文以『纯洁信仰』之名烧死异端塞维图斯，说明以己为绝对之是者掌权必行迫害
他自悔少年时代引用『必以吾辈所主张者为绝对之是』的过头话，把自我批判写进这篇文章本身
办《努力周报》《独立评论》期间坚持刊登论敌的文章，示范同刊异见的操作
反例警示：他也因在雷震案中劝雷震『容忍』而被批评为对当权者的容忍与对批评者的要求不对等——容忍论若无对权力的优先适用，就会沦为弱者的道德义务
representative_cases_en: 'Tolerance and Liberty' rests on Reformation history: Calvin, in the name of pure faith, burned the heretic Servetus—those who deem themselves absolutely right persecute once in power
He recanted his youthful line 'what we hold must be absolutely right,' writing the self-criticism into the essay itself
Running the Endeavor and Independent Critic weeklies he insisted on publishing opponents' articles, modeling same-page dissent

Counterexample: urging Lei Zhen to 'tolerate' during the Lei Zhen case drew the charge that his tolerance was asymmetric—demanded of the critics but not of power; without priority application to power, the tolerance doctrine becomes a moral duty of the weak
modern_applications_zh: 平台治理：内容规则的唯一检验标准是掌权方（平台自身）是否也受同一规则约束
组织文化：设立内部异见保护程序，且高管公开承诺接受同程序审查
社群运营：以议事规则而非管理员裁量担保异见者空间
个人修养：对『我一定对』的时刻设警钟，为对手观点写最强版本
modern_applications_en: Platform governance: the sole test of content rules is whether the power-holder (the platform itself) is bound by the same rules
Organizational culture: internal dissent-protection procedures, with executives publicly subject to the same review
Community moderation: rules of order, not admin discretion, guarantee dissenters' space
Personal discipline: an alarm for moments of 'I am certainly right'; write the strongest version of the opponent's view

modes.domain_zh: 改良主义的具体化/对革命万能论的替代
modes.domain_en: Operationalizing Reformism / An Alternative to the Omnipotence of Revolution
modes.definition_zh: 胡适的社会变革观建立在一个判断上：『文明不是笼统造成的，是一点一滴造成的』；『解放不是笼统解放，改造也不是笼统改造』。革命话语承诺一次性重置，但重置后的制度仍要靠逐日运转，而运转的具体能力无法靠宣言获得。他的替代方案是把变革单位从『制度』降为『问题』：一个一个问题研究、一项一项改造，用可核查的增量累积代替不可核查的总承诺。这不是胆怯，而是一种对复杂性的尊重——社会是耦合系统， wholesale 重置的成本总会在细节处清算。方法上这意味着：以问题清单为变革的单位，以每项的可验证改善为进度条，拒绝以最终蓝图的正当性豁免中间过程的错误。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih's view of social change rests on one judgment: 'civilization is not made wholesale but drop by drop'; 'liberation is not wholesale, nor is transformation.' Revolutionary discourse promises a one-shot reset, but the institutions after the reset must still run day by day, and the concrete capacity to run them cannot come from a manifesto. His alternative lowers the unit of change from 'the system' to 'the problem': study problems one by one, transform item by item, accumulate verifiable increments instead of unverifiable total promises. This is not timidity but respect for complexity—society is a coupled system, and the cost of a wholesale reset is always settled in the details. Methodologically: take the problem list as the unit of change and each item's verifiable improvement as the progress bar, refusing to exempt mid-process errors on the strength of a blueprint's ultimate legitimacy.
modes.source_chapter: 《新思潮的意义》『一点一滴的进化』；《介绍我自己的思想》自述改良主义立场
modes.key_quote_zh: 文明是一点一滴的进化，解放是一点一滴的解放——改造也必须是一点一滴的改造。
modes.key_quote_en: Civilization evolves drop by drop, liberation comes drop by drop—and transformation must likewise be drop by drop.
process_zh: 把总目标拆成问题清单，每项标明可验证的改善标准
优先解决『可动』的问题：从现有条件就能启动的最小改造单元入手
每项改造做完即验收并公示，用已完成清单替代宏大叙事作为合法性来源
对总蓝图保持工具化态度：蓝图随问题清单的进展而修订，不反过来为蓝图牺牲清单上的具体改善
process_en: Split the total goal into a problem list, each item marked with a verifiable improvement standard
Solve the 'movable' problems first: start from the minimal transformation units launchable under current conditions
Accept and publicize each completed item; let the completed list, not grand narrative, be the source of legitimacy
Hold the total blueprint instrumentally: revise it as the list progresses; never sacrifice concrete improvements on the list for the blueprint's sake
representative_cases_zh: 他推动的具体改良清单：国语统一、 注音识字、破除缠足、婚制改良、学校改革——每一项都可独立验收
在《我们走那条路》中提出『五鬼闹中华』（贫、病、愚、私、乱）的问题框架，主张逐一治理而非等待总爆发
办《努力周报》时提出『好政府主义』的具体条款（宪政、公开、有计划的政治），把政治主张写成可核查的清单
反例警示：渐进改良在危机条件下可能太慢而失去窗口（其论敌多持此论）——渐进法需要诚实回答『何时渐进会错过不可逆的窗口』，而非把渐进当万能药
representative_cases_en: His concrete reform list: unified national language, phonetic literacy, ending foot-binding, marriage reform, school reform—each independently verifiable
In 'Which Road Do We Take' he framed China's woes as 'five devils' (poverty, disease, ignorance, selfishness, disorder) to be governed one by one rather than awaiting a general explosion
In the Endeavor weekly he wrote 'good-government-ism' as concrete clauses (constitutionalism, openness, planned politics), turning political claims into a checkable list

Counterexample: incremental reform may be too slow in crisis conditions and lose the window (his opponents' standing argument)—the incrementalist must honestly answer 'when does gradualism miss an irreversible window,' not treat gradualism as a panacea
modern_applications_zh: 大型项目：以可验收的问题清单替代总体方案叙事，每项独立上线独立复盘
组织变革：先找『可动单元』（一个流程、一个团队），滚动扩大而非毕其功于一役
公共政策辩论：要求每个总目标配可核查的中间里程碑
个人改变：习惯改造按『一点一滴』设计，拒绝自我重置叙事
modern_applications_en: Large projects: a checkable problem list over a master-plan narrative; each item ships and reviews independently
Organizational change: find 'movable units' (one process, one team) and scale rolling, never betting on one decisive stroke
Public policy debate: every total goal must carry verifiable interim milestones
Personal change: design habit reform drop by drop, refusing the self-reset narrative

modes.domain_zh: 长期主义的心理结构/对无用感的对冲
modes.domain_en: The Psychology of Long-Termism / Hedging against Futility
modes.definition_zh: 『功不唐捐』（佛典语：功德不会白费）是胡适对抗虚无的时间哲学：他一生多次被打成过时人物——白话赢了之后被新派讥为保守，被旧派骂为名教罪人，政权更迭间两头挨打——但其回应不是转向投机，而是把每一件认真做过的功课视为不会消失的沉积：『没有一点努力是会白白丢了的』。这套方法的前提是把成果的计量单位从『一时的胜败』换为『沉积的总量』：一篇考据、一次讲演、一个被时代冷落的立场，都可能在几十年后成为别人的地基。方法上这意味着：在无法预测哪份努力会被兑现的环境里，以『只做经得起时间的工作』替代『预测什么会走红』。
modes.definition_en: 'Gong bu tang juan'—no merit is ever wasted (from the Buddhist canon)—is Hu Shih's temporal philosophy against nihilism: repeatedly branded obsolete across his life (mocked as conservative by the new camp once the vernacular won, cursed as an enemy of the moral order by the old camp, beaten from both sides amid regime change), his response was not to speculate on trends but to treat every earnest piece of work as permanent sediment: 'no effort is ever wholly lost.' The premise: switch the unit of account from 'momentary wins and losses' to 'total sediment'—a textual study, a lecture, a position cold-shouldered by the age may become someone's foundation decades later. Methodologically: in an environment where you cannot predict which effort will pay off, replace 'predict what will trend' with 'only do work that withstands time.'
modes.source_chapter: 《赠与今年的大学毕业生》(1932)：功不唐捐论；《介绍我自己的思想》
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有一点努力是会白白地丢了的——功不唐捐！
modes.key_quote_en: No effort is ever wholly wasted—no merit is ever lost in vain!
process_zh: 把计量单位从事件胜败改为沉积总量：定期盘点『我留下了什么经得起十年检验的东西』
做事时附加时间检验标准：这项工作十年后还有人需要吗
冷遇期不转向：区分『被时代冷落』与『经不起检验』——前者继续做，后者才修正
相信复利的不可见期：公开承诺长期标准，使自己在无人喝彩时仍有执行依据
process_en: Switch the unit of account from event wins/losses to total sediment: periodically inventory 'what have I left that withstands a ten-year test'
Attach a time test to every task: will this still be needed in ten years?
Do not pivot in a cold season: distinguish 'cold-shouldered by the age' from 'fails the test'—continue the former, fix only the latter
Trust the invisible phase of compounding: commit publicly to long-term standards so you retain grounds to execute when no one applauds
representative_cases_zh: 其白话文学史研究与考证工作在政治边缘化的几十年后成为大陆新文化研究 restarting 的第一手地基
《中国哲学史大纲》仅完成上卷被讥『半部哲学史』，但其范式被整代学人沿用——半部书的沉积胜过十部应时的书
抗战期间以书生身份出任驻美大使，其四年外交工作在当时的国内舆论中近乎无名，后被史家视为争取美援的关键
反例警示：长期主义可能成为回避当下责任的修辞——功不唐捐不等于任何事都该做，仍需以『经得起时间检验』为筛选器，否则沉积的是垃圾而非功德
representative_cases_en: His vernacular-literary-history research and textual studies, marginalized for decades of politics, became the first-hand foundation when mainland New Culture studies restarted
His Philosophy Outline, only its first volume done, was mocked as 'half a history of philosophy,' yet its paradigm served a whole generation—half a book's sediment outweighing ten timely ones
As wartime ambassador to the United States, four years of diplomacy were nearly unnamed in domestic opinion, later judged by historians as pivotal to securing American aid

Counterexample: long-termism can become a rhetoric for evading present duty—'no effort wasted' does not mean everything is worth doing; 'withstands the test of time' remains the filter, or you sediment garbage, not merit
modern_applications_zh: 职业冷遇期策略：以『十年检验标准』选择继续深耕还是修正，替代追风口
内容创作：做十年后仍成立的功课（原理、教程、考据），少做应时内容
组织研发：为不可见的复利期设置保护性预算，不以季度胜败裁撤
个人声誉：把承诺写成公开的长期标准，使冷遇期不致失序
modern_applications_en: Career cold-season strategy: choose deepening vs. correcting by the ten-year test, not by chasing the next wave
Content creation: do work that still holds in ten years (principles, tutorials, philology) over trend-chasing
Organizational R&D: protective budgets for the invisible compounding phase, never cut by quarterly wins
Personal reputation: write long-term standards publicly so the cold season does not unravel you

modes.domain_zh: 以自身为方法示范物/权威的去魅式领导
modes.domain_en: Making Oneself the Demonstration Object / De-Mystified Leadership by Example
modes.definition_zh: 胡适的领导方式极为特殊：他倡议的每一套方法，都先在自己身上公开做示范——倡白话则自己先写白话诗（并允许写坏）、倡怀疑则先写自我忏悔文章、倡证据则公开修正自己已出版的结论。他把『我可能错』做成了领导力资产而非负债：一个肯当众当学童的人，其倡导的方法才可信。这与传统师道的『师严而后道尊』相反——他不经营无瑕的权威，而经营可核查的诚实。方法上这意味着：推广任何新方法时，最高效的路径不是论证其正确，而是以自己的失败与修正作为公开演示数据；领导者保留被质疑的接口，方法才获得被采纳的接口。
modes.definition_en: Hu Shih's mode of leadership was singular: for every method he advocated, he first ran the demonstration on himself in public—advocating the vernacular, he wrote vernacular poems first (allowing them to be bad); advocating doubt, he wrote self-reproach essays first; advocating evidence, he publicly revised his own published conclusions. He made 'I may be wrong' a leadership asset, not a liability: only when the advocate is willing to play apprentice in public does the method he preaches become credible. This inverts the traditional Confucian teacher's 'the master is stern so the way is honored'—he managed not an unblemished authority but a checkable honesty. Methodologically: in promoting any new method, the most efficient path is not to argue its correctness but to use your own failures and revisions as open demonstration data; a leader who keeps an interface open to being questioned gives his method an interface to be adopted.
modes.source_chapter: 《尝试集》自序论自己白话诗的失败实验；《介绍我自己的思想》自述批判与修正；《容忍与自由》自我忏悔
modes.key_quote_zh: 我做白话诗，是要用自己来做试验品——试验失败也可以给别人做参考。
modes.key_quote_en: I write vernacular poems using myself as the test subject—my failures too can serve as reference for others.
process_zh: 倡导一项新方法前，先设计一个自己身上可公开执行的示范实验
公开承诺修正接口：预先声明何种证据出现时我将收回何种结论
把失败写进示范记录（《尝试集》自序即失败报告），使追随者获得真实的成本预期
定期做公开的自我批判，维持『学童身份』的可持续性，防止示范者重新变成无瑕权威
process_en: Before advocating a new method, design a demonstration experiment executable on yourself and in public
Commit openly to a revision interface: declare in advance under what evidence I shall retract what conclusion
Write failures into the demonstration record (the preface to Changshi is a failure report), giving followers a realistic cost expectation
Perform public self-critique periodically to keep the apprentice identity sustainable, lest the demonstrator congeal back into unblemished authority
representative_cases_zh: 《尝试集》以写坏的自己也承认的白话诗充当革命的第一批实验数据，其序言公开讨论哪些诗是失败的
《红楼梦考证》公开换稿修正自己的结论，把『我错了』写进学术出版物
《介绍我自己的思想》主动列出自己被两面批评的段落，把批评材料纳入自我介绍
反例警示：示范人格一旦被追随者神化，示范本身就会失效——其晚年『我的朋友胡适之』的社交化形象部分吞没了方法示范的严肃性，说明示范者必须主动抵制被偶像化
representative_cases_en: Changshi served as the revolution's first experimental data—vernacular poems even he admitted were flawed—its preface openly discussing which poems had failed
His Red Chamber textual study publicly swapped drafts and revised its own conclusions, writing 'I was wrong' into a scholarly publication
'Introducing My Own Thought' voluntarily quotes passages attacked from both flanks, folding critical material into a self-introduction

Counterexample: once followers deify the demonstrator, demonstration fails—his later social image of 'my friend Hu Shih' partly swallowed the seriousness of method-demonstration; the demonstrator must actively resist being made an idol
modern_applications_zh: 技术推广：倡导者先吃自己的狗粮并公开踩坑记录，替代完美 demo
组织领导：高管公开自己的判断修正记录，建立『可核查的诚实』文化
知识付费治理：示范者披露失败案例，使学习者获得真实成本预期
开源社区：维护者公开标记自己代码的已知缺陷，维持学童身份
modern_applications_en: Tech evangelism: the advocate dogfoods first and publishes pitfall logs, replacing the flawless demo
Organizational leadership: executives publish their own records of revised judgments, building a culture of checkable honesty
Knowledge-product governance: demonstrators disclose failure cases so learners get realistic cost expectations
Open-source communities: maintainers publicly tag known defects in their own code, keeping the apprentice identity
